ns2:course.label: Intermediate Graphic Design II
ns2:course.description: Goal-directed graphic design problem-solving with emphasis on the methods of thinking and research which precede the making of design communications; development of systems for objective problem-solving. Prerequisite: ARTD 310.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
